name: Do wall cabinets get installed before base cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Do wall cabinets get installed before base cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional installers always hang upper wall cabinets before securing lower base cabinets. Installing uppers first prevents contractors from having to lean over base units, protecting lower cabinets and subfloors from accidental dings or dropped tools. It also allows installers to set up steady step ladders and mechanical cabinet lifts directly on the subfloor. Once uppers are level, plumb, and anchored to studs, base units are installed and leveled.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, upper wall cabinets are installed first to prevent damage to base units and to give installers unobstructed room to work.
